row:
Evidence-based holistic care for cats with kidney disease and chronic illness — from an Animal Naturopath with 14+ years of experience.

If your cat has chronic kidney disease (CKD), metabolic nausea, gut issues, or a chronic condition that your vet calls "manage but not cure" — this channel is for you.

Everyone thinks holistic care means guessing. It does not. Every protocol here is grounded in science and built for the real, day-to-day life of a sick cat.

What you'll find:
🐾 Kidney disease in cats — diet, supplements, monitoring
🐾 Metabolic nausea and appetite loss — why it happens, what helps
🐾 Gut health and chronic illness — the links most vets miss
🐾 Evidence-based natural remedies — what works, what's hype


🤖 TRANSPARENCY: This channel is presented using my digital avatar. Every script is personally researched, written, and reviewed by me.
